book.title: WAI PII EPE JONEME PEPA PIAMO DOKO

content: Disaipolo Kalangeme Jisasa Kandena Lao Paneamo Doko
Maitakao Taibiriasa pete lemba dokonya disaipolo dupame dee kandena lao Jisasa baa dapa pyoo panea.

Saimone Pitapi, Tomasa kenge mende Pakao Mandipae lenge dokopi, Galali yuu dokonya taono Kena tange Nataniele lenge dokopi, Sebedi ikiningi dolapopi, Jisasanya disaipolo dupanya mendalapopi, dutupa tole kateami.

Dokopa Saimone Pitame disaipolo yangi dutupa lamaiyoo, “Namba pisa nyala pelyona” lea. Dopa leamopa disaipolo dutupame baa lamaiyoo, “Naima apata mua” leami. Dopa latala, dutupa sipi dokonya pupae pyakalyetala peami. Dopaka doko, kuka gii dokonya pisa mende nyala naeyami.
Yuu yongeamopa, Jisasa baa endaki pete lemba dokonya katea. Dokopa disaipolo dupame doko Jisasa-lamo lao nakandeami.
Dokopa Jisasame wii lao disaipolo dutupa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Wane paluma, napenge pisa mendatupa nyakamame nyalamipi?”

content: lea. Dopa leamopa disaipolo dutupame baanya pii yanu pyakamaiyoo, “Nanyalamanona” leami.
Dopa leaminopa baame dutupa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Nyakamame sipi dokonya kingi tolaetena umbene doko endakinya pyandataminopa pisa nyalaminona pyandalapa”

content: lea. Dokopa umbene doko endakinya pyandeaminopa, pisa longome umbene doko tumbia dokome, pyalya lao nyoo sipinya setapenge nanjia.

Dokopa Jisasanya mona setenge disaipolo dokome Pita lamaiyoo, “Baa Kamongo doko-lamona” lea. “Baa Kamongo doko-lamona” lea doko Saimone Pitame sepala, baanya yonge pee kisa pingi lyokanya setea doko nyoo petala, endaki pete dokonya mangau lea.

Dopaka doko, disaipolo yangi dutupame sipi yakane dokonya pituu kandeaminopa, endaki lemba doko londati nasia. Tengesa 100 mita joo siamosa, dutupame pisa paleta umbene doko pyalya lao endaki pete dokonya lembasa peami.
Endaki lemba dokonya pupala kandeaminopa, itate tao langa sia dokonya pisa mende yangatae kateamopa, breta mendatupa dosa sia.
Dokopa Jisasame dokaita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Pisa epapu nyalamino dupanya mendatupa nyoo ipupa”

content: lea.

Dopa lateamopa Saimone Pita sipi dokonya pyakalyetala, pisa paleta umbene doko pyalya lao nyoo lembasa ipupala kandeamopa, pisa andake 153 palea. Paleamopa umbene doko tumbiaka doko, umbene doko lapyala naeya.
Dokopa Jisasame disaipolo dutupa lamaiyoo,
lea. Dopa leamopa disaipolo dutupame baa Kamongo doko-lamo lao kandatala, dutupanya mendeme, “Emba apipi?” lao tipa pyaanya paka kaeyami.
Dokopa Jisasa ipupala breta doko nyoo dutupa maitala, pisa doko dopaka pyoo nyoo maiya.
Jisasa baa malunya sakatatala, baanya disaipolo dupame kandena lao dakeme paa tepo pyoo panea.
Sipisipi Dupa Setao Katakape Leamo Doko
Nee nao etapala Jisasame Saimone Pita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Jona ikiningi Saimone, datupame namba auu kaengema doko ita minao embame namba moname kiningi auu kaelyepe?”

content: lea. Dopa leamopa Pitame baa lamaiyoo, “Kamongo, nambame emba kiningi auu kaelyopa embame kandengena” lea. Dokopa Jisasame baa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Embame nambanya sipisipi ŋaŋa dupa nee maiyakape”

content: lea.
Dopa latala paa lapo pyoo baame Pita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Jona ikiningi Saimone, embame namba moname kiningi auu kaelyepe?”

content: lea. Dopa leamopa Pitame baa lamaiyoo, “Kamongo, nambame emba kiningi auu kaelyopa embame kandengena” lea. Dokopa Jisasame baa lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Embame nambanya sipisipi dupa auu pyoo setao katakape”

content: lea.
Dopa latala paa tepo pyoo baame Pita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Jona ikiningi Saimone, embame namba auu kaelyepe?”

content: lea.

lao paa tepo pyoo Jisasame tipa piamosa, Pita baa mona kenda kaeyapala Jisasa lamaiyoo, “Kamongo, embame dupa pitaka kandenge dokome, nambame emba kiningi auu kaelyopa embame kandengena” lea. Dokopa Jisasame baa lamaiyoo,

content.text: Nambame emba etete kiningi langilyo: Wamba emba wane kole kateeno dokopa, emba tange yonge pee dupa nyoo petala, patoo lao masiino dupanya pee. Dopaka doko, emba lyanga jete gii dokopa, embanya kingi dolapo tinokotenopa, endakali waka mendeme embanya yonge pee doko nyoo petakala, emba napatoo lao masete panda dokonya laminao patana”

content: lea.
Dopa lea dokome Pita dopa pyoo kumapala, Gotenya kenge doko minalyetana lao makande pyoo lea. Pii dutupa latala Jisasame Pita lamaiyoo,
lea.
Jisasanya Disaipolo Mona Setenge Dokome Etao Pepa Piamo Dutupa

Wamba nee nao peteami gii dokopa, Jisasanya mona setenge disaipolo doko Jisasa-kisa semai latae pituu, “Kamongo, emba apimi yandapipi dupanya kinginya maiyepepe” lea disaipolo dokome Jisasapa Pitapa dolapo watao epeamopa, Pitame kapilyetala kandea.
Kandatala Pitame Jisasa lamaiyoo, “Kamongo, akali dake aipa pitape?” lea.
Dokopa Jisasame Pita lamaiyoo,

content.text: “Nambanya auu kaengeme baa lenge tao katao, namba dee ipato gii dokonya tuu latana lao masoto doko embanya kalai mende daana, emba namba watao ipu”

content: lea.
Dopa leamosa, disaipolo doko kumala naeyata-lamona lao pii doko Kristene kaiminingi dupanya kainanya lao taeyami. Dopaka doko, disaipolo doko kumala naeyatana lao Jisasame baa lamaiya naeya.

content.text: “Nambanya auu kaengeme baa lenge tao katao, namba dee ipato gii dokonya tuu latana lao masoto doko embanya kalai mende daana”

content: lao baa lamaiya.
Pia dupa pitaka disaipolo pepa pia-lamo dakeme kandatala dopa piana lao panao baame pepa dake pia. Baame panao pepa pia dutupa kiningina lao naimame masilyamano.

Jisasame kalai longo mendapu apata piaka. Kalai piamo dupa pitaka mendai-mendai lao bukunya pepa piamili doko, buku eteteaka longo-waka simupa, isa yuu dakenya setapenge panda nasipyalina lao nambame masilyo.
